description.value: Pho 24 Express is a Vietnamese restaurant on Kingsway in Burnaby, self-described as the area's top Vietnamese food destination, with a menu built around phở, salad rolls, and a variety of savory starters. The restaurant is open late every day of the week, including statutory holidays, making it a reliable option for cyclists finishing a long day on the road. Catering services and reservations are also available.
